## Actual verification

Commands executed, inspected results, evidence links and limitations:

- [ ] Relevant foundation and application checks executed (list above).
- [ ] Critical positive/prohibited/concurrent cases covered where applicable.
- [ ] No test/check weakened, secret exposed or unrelated change included.
- [ ] Requirement/design/test/release traceability updated as applicable.
- [ ] Independent human review requested for high-impact changes.

## Authorisation (sensitive operations only)

Complete when the change releases, migrates, deletes data, changes permissions, touches live payment/email/shipment, or alters cloud/hosted configuration. Copy fields from [the authorisation template](../docs/governance/templates/authorization.md) into [authorizations.json](../docs/governance/authorizations.json):

- Operation / scope / environment:
- Requesting human / approving human (approver role):
- Evidence (signed change, ticket, email) / expiry:
- Execution outcome:

An AI/agent proposal or self-review is not independent human authorization. Leave this block out when the change is not sensitive; do not fill it with planned work.

Do not check a box for planned/not-run work. This template does not enforce branch protection or deployment approval.
